fileUrl.description: URL of the source metadata file. {@link #file}

lineNum.description: Line number in the source metadata file where this issue is occurring.

colNum.description: Column number in the source metadata file where this issue is occurring.

message.description: Human readable description of the issue.

targetType.description: Optional target type name for this issue.

targetField.description: Optional target type field name for this issue.

targetId.description: Optional target obj id name for this issue.

code.description: Optional category code for related issues.

title:
Describes issue with Pkg file content.

To get the full list of Pkg.Issues for a Pkg, call pkg().issues()
name: Pkg.Issue
